tasks.objective: Design one local transactional store for canonical work, plans, attempts, capabilities, coordination, evidence and effect intents. Maintain schema migration discipline and explicit read-only opens.
tasks.title: Define project-local SQLite authority and durable schema

tasks.objective: Define typed command execution and revisioned state transitions in one transaction, with receipt identity, event history and derived read models; avoid a redundant event-sourced database architecture.
tasks.title: Implement atomic transitions, revisions, idempotency and history

tasks.objective: Provide one deterministic decision engine for structural prerequisites, role/capability rights, source scopes, leases and safe parallelism. Use the same rule set for advisory reads and atomic admission, distinguishing observed eligibility from reservation.
tasks.title: Unify eligibility, authorization and conflict evaluation

tasks.objective: Replace Codex environment-variable identity and hardwired skill names with trusted host-supplied actor identity and bounded, revocable capability grants. Authorize parent and child delegation without implicit privilege escalation.
tasks.title: Introduce host-agnostic actors, grants, and scoped capabilities

tasks.objective: Attach exclusive ownership, filesystem scopes, named locks and lifecycle to attempts. Preserve dirty-work quarantine, process-unknown semantics and one-active-claim invariants; external resource reservations remain provider owned.
tasks.title: Rework claim and lease transactions around attempts

tasks.objective: Own project-local transactional state, authorization, resource-independent admission, and history.
tasks.title: Authority, transactions, and eligibility

tasks.objective: Schedule accepted work through Runs and Assignments, with deterministic queues, role constraints and optional lane structure for parallel work. No dependency on an agent/model scheduler.
tasks.title: Define runs, assignments and optional worker lanes

tasks.objective: Join assignment selection, authoritative claim, bounded capability issuance and dispatch in a coherent transaction. Make resumption stable under connection/process restart and ambiguous task/run selection.
tasks.title: Implement atomic dispatch, resumption and release

tasks.objective: Keep bounded messages, questions/answers, decisions, interface changes, rendezvous and blockers, with explicit recipient and authority scopes; do not turn the ledger into a transcript store.
tasks.title: Provide typed durable communication and decision synchronization

tasks.objective: Generate a task/assignment context capsule from the accepted plan, current decisions and source references. Version contextual findings separately; do not copy previously authored prose into successive task briefs as a source of truth.
tasks.title: Derive bounded, provenance-aware worker context

tasks.objective: Allow an authorized parent attempt to delegate bounded read/write work and receive candidate results. Children cannot become independent plan/run authorities or self-accept final outcomes.
tasks.title: Support restricted delegation and parent-mediated acceptance

tasks.objective: Coordinate concurrent human or automated workers without adopting an agent runtime.
tasks.title: Runs, assignments, and collaboration

tasks.objective: Read the original Todo implementation as reference material. Identify observable invariants, Todo contracts, tests, and historical compatibility layers. Record which behavior is product-essential and which is incidental or obsolete.
tasks.title: Inventory the original contracts and construct a behavioral baseline

tasks.objective: Specify PlanRevision, WorkItem, Requirement, Run, Assignment, Attempt, Actor, Authorization, Evidence, Outcome and ExternalOperation, including references and lifecycle boundaries. Separate declarations from execution records and separate current applicability from historical proof.
tasks.title: Ratify one canonical model of work and its invariants

tasks.objective: Ensure distribution todo-orchestrator, ergonomic Python module/CLI/skill entry points, versioned contracts, tests, no hard dependency on Project Control, and no reliance on a sibling source directory. Work with the new repository scaffold rather than overwriting it.
tasks.title: Establish standalone package boundaries and development harness

tasks.objective: Define standalone trust and provider interfaces for identity/authorization, repository/source observation, Git workspace effects, process execution, resource reservations, and evidence receipts.
tasks.title: Define explicit trust and provider contracts

tasks.objective: Define the standalone product, baseline semantics, and trust boundaries before changing source.
tasks.title: Foundation and product contracts

tasks.objective: Build clean domain-oriented application APIs, `todo` CLI entry points and a standalone SKILL.md that teaches agents how to plan and execute. Expose bounded receipts, errors and actionable next steps; keep internal state machines private.
tasks.title: Expose stable standalone Python, CLI and skill interfaces

tasks.objective: Define how standalone Todo requests externally owned resource permits and execution receipts. Keep background worker supervision and CUDA-specific paths outside the canonical engine.
tasks.title: Define standalone external execution and resource providers

tasks.objective: Expose independently usable Python, CLI, and skill interfaces with trusted provider contracts.
tasks.title: Standalone interfaces and provider contracts

tasks.objective: Implement a documented, expressive plan input that supports authored objectives, structured work, scope, decisions, acceptance, alternatives, provenance and explicit unknowns. Compile deterministically to the canonical domain model, independent of running workers.
tasks.title: Specify and compile first-class machine plan packages

tasks.objective: Unify tasks, checkpoints, interfaces, decisions, barriers, rendezvous and result requirements under one typed dependency engine. Verify whole-graph cycles and explain unsatisfied, unavailable, and unresolved states.
tasks.title: Validate the complete typed dependency and condition graph

tasks.objective: Diff compiled declarations against accepted definitions without simulating arbitrary writes on a copied database. Produce precise additions, updates, retirements, impacts and conflicts, preserving historical intent and omitted fields.
tasks.title: Produce deterministic, inspectable change sets

tasks.objective: Commit typed change sets transactionally with optimistic authority preconditions, explicit actor authorization and stable idempotency. Treat mutation of active or completed work as a guarded lifecycle change.
tasks.title: Commit plan revisions and replan safely

tasks.objective: Make structured plan compilation, dependency validation, and safe change-set application first-class.
tasks.title: Machine planning and controlled revision

tasks.objective: Build disposable fixtures from the old Todo implementation for plans, claim contention, delegation, gates, integration, dirty recovery, and semantics. Classify intentional behavior changes.
tasks.title: Capture pre-redesign reference fixtures and safety expectations

tasks.objective: Exercise property-based or model-based tests of graph validity, no-op ingestion, competing claims, capability revocation, lane scheduling and decision consistency.
tasks.title: Qualify planning, admission and multi-agent safety properties

tasks.objective: Inject failures at each external-operation stage, changing file contents during gates, interrupted workspace creation and conflicting integration. Prove quarantine and historical proof invariants.
tasks.title: Qualify validation, external effects and crash recovery

tasks.objective: Complete standalone README, API/CLI/skill reference, schema and backup/restore docs, operational guide, release/source pin, and qualification evidence.
tasks.title: Deliver standalone release and operator documentation

tasks.objective: Prove standalone safety, compatibility, packaging, recovery, and release readiness.
tasks.title: Standalone qualification and release

tasks.objective: Determine authoritative reconciliation from attempt, lease, workspace, evidence and external-effect records. Distinguish expired, unknown-live, dirty, irrecoverable and safely retryable states.
tasks.title: Create unified inspection of interrupted and uncertain operations

tasks.objective: Prepare approved recovery actions, revalidate the exact authority inside the mutation transaction, and preserve state, workspaces and tokens that cannot be safely revoked.
tasks.title: Apply safe and auditable recovery transitions

tasks.objective: Make plan supersession and quiescent run retirement explicit, with successor lineage, preserving accepted work and user-authorized handoffs. Avoid special-purpose SQL rewriting as the only route.
tasks.title: Supersede, retire and replace work without history loss

tasks.objective: Expose stable versioned read models and derived human-readable views; snapshots are backups/interchange artifacts, not silent startup restoration. Require explicit identity and revision checks for restoration.
tasks.title: Add trustworthy export, projections and explicit restoration

tasks.objective: Reconcile interruptions and preserve work, evidence, and authoritative provenance.
tasks.title: Recovery and lifecycle

tasks.objective: Deliver an independently usable, transactional workflow and planning engine for Todo Orchestrator.
tasks.title: Deliver standalone todo-orchestrator v1

tasks.objective: Retain declared gates, checkpoints and evidence contracts without embedding concrete runners. Make required evidence and accepted negative results first-class, distinguishing acceptance from runtime exit status.
tasks.title: Specify typed verification and acceptance requirements

tasks.objective: Use durable gate-attempt identities and prepared/executing/observed/finalized lifecycle. Call trusted provider interfaces for actual commands/resources; correlate completion with source identity, operation identity and receipts.
tasks.title: Track verification attempts and external execution receipts

tasks.objective: Require current applicable evidence for successful dispositions at the final commit, while preserving immutable historical acceptance records. Recheck dependency/requirement inputs after external execution and at acceptance.
tasks.title: Implement provenance-preserving acceptance of work outcomes

tasks.objective: Adapt existing conservative Git-worktree, artifact and integration behavior behind a trusted repository-effects provider. Preserve operation-intent, idempotent receipt and conflict-recovery semantics without coupling the domain engine to subprocess Git details.
tasks.title: Isolate and qualify Git workspace/integration operations

tasks.objective: Verify outputs against precise source/input identities and use external providers for effects.
tasks.title: Verification and safe integration
